scenarios.title: Direct QR scan displays note form before submission
given: a user accesses a direct QR scan link for a badge
scenarios.when: the direct QR scan interface loads
then: a note entry form is presented to the user before the scan is finalized
a clear option labeled "Submit without note" is visible on the form

scenarios.title: Submit scan with an entered note
given: the direct QR scan note form is displayed
the user has entered a note (e.g. "Met at booth 12")
scenarios.when: the user submits the note form
then: confirmation that the scan was recorded with the note is displayed

scenarios.title: Submit scan using the submit without note option
given: the direct QR scan note form is displayed
scenarios.when: the user chooses the "Submit without note" option
then: confirmation that the scan was recorded without a note is displayed

scenarios.title: Submit scan using standard submit with empty note input
given: the direct QR scan note form is displayed
the note input field is left empty
scenarios.when: the user submits the form using the primary submit button
then: the scan submission completes successfully without a note
confirmation that the scan was recorded is displayed

scenarios.title: Display vendor code when vendor has already been selected via cookie
given: a vendor has already been selected via cookie (e.g. vendor code "VEND101")
scenarios.when: the user accesses a direct QR scan link
then: the selected vendor code (e.g. "VEND101") is visibly displayed in the scan flow

scenarios.title: Vendor code is omitted when vendor cookie is not present
given: no vendor has been selected and no vendor cookie is present
scenarios.when: the user accesses a direct QR scan link
then: no vendor code is displayed in the scan flow

scenarios.title: Vendor code is omitted when vendor cookie is blank or invalid
given: the vendor cookie is present but contains an empty or whitespace value
scenarios.when: the user accesses a direct QR scan link
then: no vendor code is displayed in the scan flow
